Attorney General Settles with AdTracker LLC over CCPA Violations, Secures $500,000

May 20, 2026

The Attorney General today announced a settlement with AdTracker LLC resolving alleged violations of the CCPA and consumer privacy protections. Under the settlement, the company will pay $500,000 in civil penalties and delete unlawfully collected personal information.

Attorney General Announces New Road Safety Campaign

May 18, 2026

The Attorney General launched a public awareness campaign to promote road safety across the state.
